definition.confirmed: CONFIRMED iff (meanNetR > +0.10R AND day-clustered tNet > 2) AND (excessVsRandomR > 0 AND day-clustered t > 2) AND all vetoes clear (n >= 100, concentration <= 0.50, LOYO >= 0.75, NO_BASELINE).
definition.meanNetR: absolute net R mean, signed by claim direction, net of the frozen cost model
definition.excessVsRandomR: mean of (netR_i - matchedBaselineMean_i), signed by claim direction
definition.trueNetEdge: the assumed TRUE absolute net mean R per trade for the simulated cell, evaluated at 0.05R, 0.10R, 0.20R and 0.30R. The simulated excess is (edge - b) where b is the MEASURED verdict-state baseline mean.
definition.probability: estimated as confirmed/400 over deterministic Monte Carlo runs

inputs.tradeCount: MEASURED DEV signal count AFTER the one-slot book (slot-model.json)
inputs.calendarDays: MEASURED DEV calendar-day counts per (verdict state, session) from the Map
inputs.yearSpread: MEASURED DEV bar counts per year per verdict state (exercises the concentration and LOYO vetoes)
inputs.perTradeSD: the random baseline's own measured SD for that verdict state
inputs.dayCorrelation: a day-level shock of 0.55 * SD added to every trade on that day (CR1-realistic)
inputs.matchedBaselineMean: MEASURED verdict-state baseline mean from random-baseline.json
inputs.harness: the REAL verifyClaim() from lib/verification.mjs, with a controlled baseline

assumptions.perTradeSD: the baseline's measured SD is used as the strategy's SD. This is an assumption: a real strategy's dispersion may differ.
assumptions.dayCorrelation: 0.55 * SD is an assumption about within-day correlation, calibrated to the baseline's own measured inflation.
assumptions.yearSpread: trades are spread across DEV years proportional to MEASURED bar counts; a real strategy's year distribution may differ, which would change the concentration and LOYO veto outcomes.
assumptions.slotModel: the trade count uses the task-4 slot model, which is itself an assumption.
assumptions.noOutcomes: no strategy result exists; every input above is either measured from this project's own data or explicitly flagged as an assumption.
